notes.title: An apology announcement and statement
notes.content:
Dear players




I apologize for some of the things that happened before. Due to my lack of experience, I interfered with players' comments for personal reasons after the game was released, including public questioning and insults, which seriously affected players' behavior. At present, I have deeply realized my own problem, accepted everyone's criticism, and promised not to interfere with players' behavior in the future. I hereby publicly apologize and apologize.

Regarding the issue of fraudulent advertising during the early stages of game release:

In the early stages of game release, this game used titles such as "suspense", "thriller", and "magic" for promotion. Some players may have confused the difference between "suspense thriller" and "suspense reasoning". This game does contain suspense tricks, but does not include reasoning components. It was not until players raised the issue of "no options in the later stages of the game" that 41 multiple-choice questions were added in an update to clarify the tricks in the game. Due to the difficulty of some players raising these questions, the number of questions was reduced to 15. Currently, the "suspense" tag of the game has been removed to prevent other players from confusing it. The game tag on the Steam store allows players to change it themselves. If they still feel that the game description is too difficult, they can delete it. Wrong players can add reasonable tags on their own.





Wishing all players a happy life and all their wishes come true.
